services.name: 2-Hour Sail
services.desc: A unique way to experience Maine and discover the hidden secrets of the Saco River and Saco Bay in an intimate setting of no more than 6. Have fun and create memories that will last a lifetime! Reserve a spot for a 2 hour escape sail, relax and enjoy the beauty of the Saco River, Biddeford Pool, Camp Ellis, Wood Island Lighthouse and Old Orchard Beach. We limit this tour to 2/3 the ship's rated capacity. This provides our guests with plenty of seating and room to spread out for a truly enjoyable experience on the water. All ages are welcome! Boat Departures 2 to 4 times daily, Per Person

services.name: Private 2-Hour Sail
services.desc: Reserve the entire boat for your own private charter. Discover the hidden secrets of the Saco River and Saco Bay in an intimate setting of no more than 6. Relax into the beauty of the Maine Coast as we serve you. Enjoy the storied history of the Saco River, Biddeford Pool, Camp Ellis, Wood Island Lighthouse and Old Orchard Beach. All ages are welcome! Boat Departures 2 to 4 times daily, based on time of the year. Departure times vary based on when the sunsets, see schedule for daily times. Sailing in a Larger Group Most of the season 2 sailboats will be available with a capacity Up To 6/Boat

services.name: Sunset Sail
services.desc: Book your evening cruise and soak in the peace of watching the sun set over the ocean's endless expanse of horizon. Watch in wonder as the world glows with gorgeous red, oranges, yellows and purples. Each sunset is unique, different and so so beautiful! We limit this tour to 2/3 the ship's rated capacity and take no more than 6 guests. This provides our guests with plenty of seating and room to spread out for a truly enjoyable experience on the water. All ages are welcome! Boat Departures Once daily, departure times vary based on when the sunsets, see schedule for daily times. Per Person • 2 Hours

services.name: Private Full Moon Charter
services.desc: If you never have seen a full moon rise from a boat you are in for a unique experience! Come make special memories with friends or/and family! Book online today! Watch the full moon rise while taking in the breathtaking beauty of Saco Bay! These Charters are timed to watch the moon rise after the sun sets based on the below schedule. Flower Moon - May 2 - Starts 8:00pm Blue Moon - May 29 - 31 - Starts between 7:00 to 8:00pm Strawberry Moon - June 27 - 29 - Starts between 7:00 to 8:00pm Buck Moon - July 27 - 31 - Starts between 7:00 to 8:00pm Sturgeon Moon - August 26 - September Up To 6/Boat • 2 Hours

quotes.author: Lucie
quotes.text: ⛵️OH WAH⛵️! Probably our best experience in Maine. AbbyLynn and her husband are 2 amazing human beings, professional sailors and lovers of the nature. They are so kind and generous... they event let me navigate their beautiful sailing ship. We had an amazing sunset, and 2 hours of pleasure. I recommend it to everyone. We saw plenty of gorgeous islands. Thank you to both of you, our holidays were even better thanks to you ⛵️ BRAVO!

quotes.author: Louis
quotes.text: AbbyLynn and Bob were great hosts! I could not have asked for a better experience. Their knowledge and skill made us feel safe and secure. They shared their lives with us and gave us great insight to area and its history. Bob also taught me about sailing and let me pilot his boat for a good portion of the sail. I highly recommend this experience to all. You will be very happy with them and their excellent hosting.

quotes.author: Marissa
quotes.text: We can’t thank Abby & Bob enough for such an unforgettable, once in a lifetime experience! if you are in the area & wanna try something different that will literally take your breath away with stunning views & warm your soul with great company from the hosts THIS IS IT! This was my first time on a sailboat & it definitely won’t be last, especially not with Abby & Bob! Incredible experience, highlight of our trip!

We had a perfect day and Abby and Bob were the perfect hosts. They went way above and beyond to make sure that our experience was great, and it was. It’s easy to tell that they love what they do and they were very knowledgeable about the area, both in the present and the past... Don’t wait to book yours, and who knows? Bob might even let you drive the boat! ;)

Spent 2 days aboard the Astraea. I can’t say enough about the sailing experience I had with this exceptional group of folks. Their experience, knowledge of the area and the pure love I felt was one of the best experiences of my 2 month trip across the US. Hope to come back and spend an entire week sailing with Broad Reach and team. Thanks Bob and Jonathan!

Bob and Ben were amazing! We did the sunset cruise and it exceeded expectations. Bob and Ben were so accommodating; from taking pictures and filling our cups with the champagne we brought to offering blankets and great conversation. The boat was beautiful and we learned a lot about the history of the land around us. I highly recommend this cruise.
